name: Dual Camera Snapshot
summary: One post made of two photos from one moment: the back camera fills the frame and the front camera sits in a small inset. A time stamp and a late mark show that it was not planned.

philosophy.core_thesis: Proof of a real moment: two cameras fire at once, there is no edit, and the late mark shows that the poster did not stage it.
design_principles: Take both photos in one 2-second window: the back camera fills the frame and the front camera fills an inset.
Place the inset at the top left, 28% of the frame width, with a 2px white border and a 12px radius.
Allow no filter, no crop and no edit: keep the raw colour and the phone noise.
Show a time stamp such as '14:32' and a late mark such as '2h late' in a mono face at 12px under the photo.
Set the page on pure black (#0B0B0B) so that the photo carries all the colour.
Limit the caption to 1 line of 40 characters or fewer, in white.
Show friends in a list sorted by time, with one tile for each person and a blur on tiles not yet unlocked.

layout.grid_mechanics: A full-width 3:4 photo with a small inset at the top left; a feed of such tiles in one column of 390px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 15% stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: The photo fills the width; the inset sits 12px from the top and left edges; the time stamp aligns flush left below the photo.
layout.container_geometry: A photo with a 16px radius; an inset with a 12px radius and a 2px white border; a pill for the late mark with a 999px radius.

font_pairings.note: A bold grotesque for the title and a neutral body face.
A narrow, bold face for a title with a mono time stamp.
A mono face for the time stamp and the late mark.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0em; the time stamp takes +0.04em.
hierarchy_rules: Set the time stamp in a mono face at 12px.
Use white text only; use red only for the late mark.

color.palette_structure: A pure black ground with white text, one late red and one time-stamp amber; photos supply all other colour.
color.contrast_rules: White text on black holds at least 18:1; red and amber carry the late mark and the time stamp only.
color.surface_treatment: A flat black ground; the photo carries raw phone colour; no filter on any element.
color.light_and_shadow: Natural, uneven light in the photos with phone noise; the chrome has no shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone viewfinder: black bars, a live frame and a small selfie inset.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px white border on the inset; no border on the main photo.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 24px blur on locked friend tiles; no cast shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 24px with round ends: camera flip, comment, location and send.
ornamentation_details.illustration: No drawn art; a small emoji reaction as a round photo of the face, 40px.

motion.transition_physics: A 2-minute timer shows a ring that fills over 120s; the shutter flashes white for 120ms; the inset swaps with the main photo in 250ms on tap.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on the inset swaps the two views; a long press on a tile shows the full photo at 100% for the hold time.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a small, honest closeness: a real look at an ordinary moment.

avoid_when: The brand needs polished, staged imagery.
The product photo must be flawless.
The audience wants entertainment more than honesty.

modifiers.how: Allow 6 to 20 images, stickers, marker words and mixed ratios.
Apply one preset, remove the inset and lay the photos in a 3-column grid.
Add a matte warm grade and a pale off-white ground.

pack.why: A solid, bold family that reads well on a black camera screen.

ground.why: The ground is a plain black field: a camera viewfinder with nothing behind the photo.
